name: onmhj
description: Local AI-session worklog capture with confirmed-date report retries.

interface.longDescription: Captures Codex hook events to local JSONL, then auto-enqueues unconfirmed report dates that flush device-tagged raw and language-aware markdown logs to a user-registered git repository. Flush pulls and merges existing raw logs before committing, and shared device confirmations let slow machines lower the confirmed floor for retries. Daily report generation defaults to active Codex/Claude Code auth; API mode is reserved for explicit bulk backfills.
